messages:
Priya: Quick shoutout — massive thanks to Sam and Diego for staying late to stomp that memory leak during the release. You two saved the demo tomorrow 🙌 :sunflower:
Diego: not me alone — huge props to Sam for spotting the bad cache key. Team effort! :muscle:
Sam: hotfix + extra logs pushed. went from 95% CPU to normal after reset. coffee and pastries tomorrow on me ☕🥐
Ava: Yesss. +1 for pastries. Can we make it a tea trolley? (some of us are dramatic about scones) :tea:
Maya: Sending a tiny trophy and a handwritten thank-you card to the infra crew. Let me know who to include. :trophy:
Priya: Maya — please include Diego, Sam, and Ella (she triaged logs while juggling support). Ella — I owe you a cookie. :cookie:
Ella: lol I just followed the breadcrumbs in the logs. Also dropping a goofy screenshot of the error pattern: https://img.mock/screenshot-err-123.png :grin:
deploy-bot: Release v2.11.4 deployed to production at 2024-06-01T02:45:09Z — no active alerts post-deploy.
Diego: Delightful. Thanks everyone for the quick responses. Night team, you’re heroes. :cape:
Sam: Heading home now. Will set up a short retro note first thing. Feel free to DM if you notice anything odd overnight.
Ava: Can we start a tiny poll for midnight pastry choices? Croissant / Scone / Muffin. React with :croissant:, :scone:, or :muffin: :joy:
Priya: poll open. also — repeat kudos in #all-hands tomorrow? Small shout from leadership would be great.
Maya: I’ll put it on the all-hands agenda. Thanks again team. :sparkles:
